maz-kanata.bio: A tiny, ancient pirate queen who has run a castle on Takodana for a thousand years. She kept Luke's old lightsaber in her vaults and gave Rey her first push towards her destiny.

rose-tico.name: Rose Tico
rose-tico.bio: A Resistance maintenance worker whose sister Paige died bombing a dreadnought. She joined Finn on a mission to Canto Bight and saved him on Crait, believing in saving what we love rather than fighting what we hate.

amilyn-holdo.name: Vice Admiral Holdo
amilyn-holdo.bio: A Resistance commander who took charge after Leia was injured. Mistrusted by Poe, she quietly saved the Resistance by staying aboard the Raddus and ramming it through Snoke's flagship at lightspeed.

zorii-bliss.name: Zorii Bliss
zorii-bliss.bio: The masked leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi and Poe Dameron's old partner from his smuggling days, who helped the heroes get into the First Order's flagship.

osha-aniseya.name: Osha
osha-aniseya.bio: One of twin sisters created through the Force by a coven on Brendok, who was taken in by the Jedi after the coven was destroyed. She left the Order and worked as a mechanic, until her sister's murders dragged her back into the Jedi's world.

mae-ho-aniseya.name: Mae
mae-ho-aniseya.bio: Osha's twin, raised by the coven and taught to hate the Jedi for what happened on Brendok. She became an assassin hunting the Jedi involved, guided by a mysterious master.

sol.name: Master Sol
sol.bio: A kind, respected Jedi Master who once trained Osha and was part of the mission to Brendok. As the assassin closes in on the Jedi from that mission, he has to face what really happened there.

qimir.name: Qimir
qimir.bio: Also called the Stranger, a former Jedi Padawan turned Sith who poses as a harmless smuggler while secretly training Mae. He hides on the ocean world of Bal'demnic.

jecki-lon.name: Jecki Lon
jecki-lon.bio: Master Sol's calm, skilled Padawan, who joins the hunt for the assassin and fights bravely when the mission turns deadly.

yord-fandar.name: Yord Fandar
yord-fandar.bio: A by-the-book Jedi Knight and old friend of Osha's from her days as a Padawan, who goes with Master Sol on the hunt for the assassin.

indara.name: Master Indara
indara.bio: A Jedi Master who led the mission to Brendok, and the first target of the assassin, ambushed in a cantina on Ueda.

vernestra-rwoh.name: Vernestra Rwoh
vernestra-rwoh.bio: A Jedi Master of the High Republic who became a Jedi Knight at just fifteen. In The Acolyte she sits on the Jedi Council, and the Stranger has a connection to her past.

crawl.title: A NEW HOPE
text: The Galactic Empire rules the galaxy through fear. A small band of rebels fights back from hidden bases.
Rebel spies have stolen the plans for the Empire's newest weapon, a battle station able to destroy an entire planet.
Now Princess Leia races home with the plans aboard her ship, as an Imperial Star Destroyer closes in behind her....

crawl.title: THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK
text: The Rebels destroyed the Death Star, but the Empire has struck back hard, hunting them from one hiding place to the next.
Luke Skywalker and his friends have taken refuge on the frozen world of Hoth, under constant watch for Imperial patrols.
Darth Vader, determined to find young Skywalker, has sent thousands of probe droids out across the galaxy....

crawl.title: RETURN OF THE JEDI
text: Luke Skywalker has come home to Tatooine to rescue his friend Han Solo from the palace of the vile gangster Jabba the Hutt.
Far away, the Empire is secretly building a second, even more powerful Death Star above the forest moon of Endor.
Once it is finished, the Emperor plans to crush the Rebellion for good. The Rebel fleet is gathering for one last stand....

crawl.title: THE PHANTOM MENACE
text: The Galactic Republic has stood for a thousand generations, but its Senate is slow and its grip on the outer worlds is slipping.
Angry at new taxes on the trade routes, the greedy Trade Federation has surrounded the peaceful planet of Naboo with a fleet of battleships, daring the Republic to stop them.
Hoping to end the crisis quietly, the Chancellor has sent two Jedi Knights to talk the Federation's leaders down....

Senator Padmé Amidala, who has spoken against an army, is returning to Coruscant for the vote. Someone wants to make sure she never arrives....

text: The Clone Wars have raged for three years across countless worlds, and the Jedi have become generals.
In a daring strike on the capital, the cyborg General Grievous has kidnapped Supreme Chancellor Palpatine from the heart of Coruscant.
As the Separatist flagship tries to escape the battle above the city, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker lead a desperate mission to bring the Chancellor home....

crawl.title: THE FORCE AWAKENS
text: Luke Skywalker has disappeared. In his absence, the First Order has risen from the ashes of the Empire, determined to hunt him down.
General Leia Organa leads a small Resistance against it, hoping to find her brother and bring him back.
She has sent her best pilot to the desert world of Jakku, where an old friend may hold a clue to where Luke has gone....

crawl.title: THE LAST JEDI
text: The First Order has struck back after the loss of Starkiller Base, and the Republic it destroyed cannot help.
Supreme Leader Snoke's fleet is closing in on the Resistance as it tries to escape its base on D'Qar.
Meanwhile, Rey has found Luke Skywalker on a distant island, and hopes he will return to fight for the galaxy....

crawl.title: THE RISE OF SKYWALKER
text: A strange voice is broadcasting across the galaxy, the voice of the long-dead Emperor Palpatine.
General Leia Organa sends her agents searching for the source, while Rey continues her Jedi training.
Supreme Leader Kylo Ren hunts for the Emperor too, determined to destroy anyone who could threaten his rule....
